title: App context
description: One per project (e2e/context/app.yaml). What the app is and the rules every generated test must follow.

app.description: Name of the app under test.

purpose.description: One or two sentences on who uses it and why. Gives agents the business 'why' behind the tests.

stack.description: Frameworks and services that affect how to test it (e.g. 'React SPA with hash routes', 'Postgres with row-level security').

locators.description: Locator rules in priority order, e.g. 'getByRole with accessible name', 'getByLabel', 'getByTestId as last resort'.

data.description: How tests get their data, e.g. 'every test creates its own user via the user fixture'.

avoid.description: Things generated tests must never do.

untestable.description: Areas the agents should not try to automate, and why (e.g. third-party OAuth popups, canvas maps).
